question.text: What is required before a client can start trading in ETIRD?

answer.text: Client must open a trading account, complete KYC, submit required account-opening documents, acknowledge rights and obligations, and receive/sign the risk disclosure document
Only a PAN card copy is sufficient
No documentation is required for ETIRD as it is a low-risk product
Client must obtain prior approval from SEBI

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM Series IV (pp.195, 328, 329), before trading a client must open a trading account, complete KYC, submit the standard account-opening documents (including UCC/PAN details), acknowledge the rights-and-obligations document, and receive/sign the risk disclosure document. The Trap: PAN alone is not sufficient — it is one part of KYC. ETIRD is not a no-documentation product, and individual clients do not need to obtain prior SEBI approval. Note: The risk disclosure document is particularly important for IRD because of the interest-rate-risk exposures involved; clients should be walked through it before they sign.
